'''Jolis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
Stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], he led a Republic squadron until they were ambushed by Imperial anti-aircraft guns. He tasked a Republic spacer to recover the stolen databanks out of their crashed fighters and demolish the anti-aircraft guns before more Republic squadrons fall.<ref name="TOR" />
